algorithm_semantics.prediction_score_rule: rank the fixed upstream-selected candidate sites by descending prediction support
algorithm_semantics.ranking: descending score with stable mergesort ordering

controls.negative_control_interpretation: The first selected-site ranking failure still exceeds the Pearson floor, proving correlation alone cannot protect the decision contract.

derivation_independence: Hosted Linux, Windows, and macOS observations are not inputs to this derivation. Candidate measurements are evaluated only after this reference-only budget has been constructed.

perturbation_model.clipping: none required inside the derived boundary
perturbation_model.description: Lower the higher-ranked score and raise the immediately lower-ranked score for the narrowest adjacent gap among fixed selected sites. This is the minimum-L1 and minimum-L-infinity additive perturbation that can change a ranked prediction-output decision.
perturbation_model.name: decision-directed symmetric boundary-pair perturbation

score_driven: selected top-30 sites fixed by the upstream scoring surface
protected_decisions.structural_rule: The perturbation is applied to the completed reference prediction matrix; labels, shape, masks, upstream class assignments, attrition, provenance, and diagnostics are held identical.

safety_factor.rule: one-half of each independently derived first-failure boundary
